headline: Strategy's weekly ATM and bitcoin update: no shares sold, no bitcoin bought, $205M of its own preferred repurchased
reasoning: Source: Strategy's 8-K filed 08:49 ET, items 8.01 and 7.01. Quoted: 'did not sell any shares under its at-the-market offering program and did not purchase or sell any bitcoin'; it holds 'approximately 848,517 bitcoin'.
The only activity was 2,068,459 STRC preferred shares repurchased for $204.9M from USD Cash. That is preferred stock, not MSTR common, and under 1% of the company.
Strategy files this update every Monday, so it is routine. Pre-market: -1.7% on a single 140-share IEX print, which tracks bitcoin, not this filing.
objections: A routine weekly disclosure with nothing new for the common stock.
